message.content:
The theory of relativity was developed by **Albert Einstein**.  
- **Special Relativity** was first published in **1905** (the paper “On the Electrodynamics of Moving Bodies”).  
- **General Relativity** followed, with its full formulation presented in **1915** (the paper “The Field Equations of Gravitation” and the subsequent 1916 publication “The Theory of Relativity”).
